ios.desc:
Who does not know this problem. The end of the term is really close but you don't know, if your marks are good enough to pass.
PlusPoints helps you to manage your marks and averages.

You just have to enter your marks and PlusPoints will do all the magic. 


***Functions***

- Average calculator
- Dreamgrade calculator
- Add and remove your own subjects
- Changeable number of exams
- Changeable weighting of every exam
- Exams with subgrades
- Use and share templates
- PlusPoints calculator
- Export your marks

android.desc:
Keeping track of your grades shouldn't be a hassle. PlusPoints does the math for you, so you always know exactly where you stand - and what it'll take to get where you want to be.

On iOS, PlusPoints has been trusted by students since 2009, with over 300,000 downloads across platforms and thousands of daily active users. Now it's just as polished on Android.

WHAT PLUSPOINTS OFFERS YOU
♦ Organize your semesters, subjects and exams in one place
♦ See your average calculated automatically, rounded exactly how you like
♦ The pluspoints system used by Swiss gymnasiums: insufficient grades must be compensated twice over by sufficient ones
♦ Handle multi-part exams with sub-grades - oral and written, weekly tests, whatever your teacher throws at you
♦ Use the dream-grade calculator to see exactly what score you need on your next exam
♦ Color-code your grades from low to high, so you can spot how you're doing at a glance
♦ Export and import semesters - back them up, or share them with friends
♦ Switch between light and dark mode, depending on the time of day or your mood
♦ Available in English, German, French and Italian

PlusPoints keeps track for you, so you can focus on the exam.

quotes.text:
On iOS our app PlusPoints already exists since 2009 and has over 250k downloads and thousands of daily active users. Now we finally released it for Android as well. As usual, we keep it completely free and ad-free.

With the app, students can manage their grades by creating semesters, subjects and exams. The latter two can be weighted and there is an option to create sub-exams, e.g. in case there is an oral as well as a written part or weekly exams are aggregated. Furthermore, semesters can be exported and imported, either as a backup or to share it with friends.
We hope that the app is useful to many more students and would appreciate if you spread the word in case you like it.
